Added tasks/gate-strength-contract-smoke.ts (11 checks), registered in lattice.config.json validate set, + CHANGELOG entry. receipt-bundle.ts reused unmodified.
usage: Run: node packages/main/dist/tasks/gate-strength-contract-smoke.js (hermetic). Programmatic: import { runGateStrength, oracleReviewer, gateStrengthBundle, verifyGateStrengthResult } from core/gate-strength; runGateStrength(reviewer, corpus) -> {catchRate, falseBlock, ...}; gateStrengthBundle(result, id, binding, key) -> offline-verifiable ReceiptBundle.
expectedOutcome: The contract smoke prints a passing line: test-only caught 0/N, block-all catchRate 1.0 but falseBlock>0, oracle DOMINATES both, all-genuine/invalid corpus rejected, receipt verifies offline + tamper-evident, result<->receipt loop closed; exit 0.
actualTranscript: ✓ gate-strength contract smoke passed: test-only caught 0/3 (visible-test gap), block-all catchRate 1.0 but falseBlock 1 (catchRate gameable), oracle DOMINATES both (catchRate 1.0 + falseBlock 0), all-genuine/invalid corpus rejected, receipt verifies offline + tamper-evident, result↔receipt loop closed. (11/11 checks, exit 0; full npm test exit 0.)
outcomeDiff: No difference — expected and actual match exactly (11/11 checks pass).
limitations: Hermetic slice 1: the three reviewers are REFERENCE endpoints/oracle (oracleReviewer reads the harness-provided defectKind label, not the artifact). A live claude -p review-lane reviewer (reads the artifact, lands inside the box) and continuous/scheduled running are explicit follow-ups. The receipt binds a digest of the result; verifyGateStrengthResult must be run to confirm a given result matches its receipt. No gate-behavior/DONE-policy/receipt-bundle.ts semantic change.
pitfalls: Reviewing then fixing in REVIEW stranded the round-1 review bindings (whole-tree diffPack includes .lattice metadata, so every metadata commit drifts diffPackHash -> review-hash-freshness stale); resolved by refreshing stale evidence + re-binding lanes + relying on the lifecycle-artifact non-blocking rows; REVIEW->TEST then passed. Material-code DONE floor requires 3 local rounds x 2 hosts (autopilot_review_submit verdicts) even when escalation is not-required. Genuine cross-host value: host-2 Codex caught 4 findings (2 High) the 4 Claude lanes missed — catchRate gameability, tamper-evidence over-claim, empty-corpus vacuity, localeCompare non-determinism — plus corroborated the oracle mislabel; all 7 fixed + re-verified by Codex round-2.
